title: Sum of Total Strength of Wizards
goal: Sum minimum strength times total strength over every contiguous group modulo 1000000007.
strategy: A monotonic stack assigns every subarray to one minimum occurrence. Prefix sums of prefix sums aggregate the total strengths of all ranges owned by that occurrence without enumerating those ranges.
